name: Snowblind
text: Reach: 1. Damage: 1d6, Blind until the end of their next turn.

name: Frost Shield
text: Castable only while Defending. Gain 2×KEY temp HP until the start of your next turn.

source.note: Temp HP is not a damage/heal roll, so no roll is encoded.

name: Shatter
text: Range: 12. Damage: 3d6. ANY die can crit vs a Hampered target. On crit: +20 damage (instead of rolling any additional dice).
upcast: Increase a die roll by 1 and +5 damage on crit.

source.note: The "Hampered." sidebar printed under this spell is a general condition definition, not part of the spell, so it is not in text. The special crit rule (any die vs Hampered, +20 instead of extra dice) is text only.

name: Omenrime
text: Reach: 6. Roll 1d6; you may replace any single die rolled within Reach with that die (it expires at the end of the encounter if unused). Replacing a die. Swap the die for your d6; treat it as if that die were the original roll.

source.note: "Replacing a die." is a sidebar box printed under the spell (after the Upcast line); appended to text. The 1d6 is not damage/healing, so no roll is encoded.

name: Rimeblades
text: Concentration: 1 min. Reach: 12, AoE. Conjure icy blades in 5 contiguous spaces; this area is Difficult Terrain. Creatures there (or who enter later) suffer 2d6 damage for each space they touch.

source.note: Roll is the 2d6 per space touched; the player rolls it once per space.

name: Arctic Blast
text: Reach: Cone 4, AoE. Damage: 4d6+10. This area is Difficult Terrain for 1 round. Any already Hampered creatures there are Restrained (frozen in place).

name: Glacier Strike
text: Range: 12, 3×3 AoE. Damage: d66 bludgeoning. Creatures adjacent to that area take half as much. The entire area permanently becomes Difficult Terrain.

source.note: The "D66." sidebar printed under this spell is the general definition of d66 dice (also used by Arctic Annihilation, and handled by the dice engine), not spell-specific, so it is not in text (question for rules owner).

name: Arctic Annihilation
text: Reach: 12, AoE. Any targets you choose are encased in ice and immune to damage and negative effects until the start of their next turn. All others take d66 damage, then make a STR save or be Incapacitated until the end of their next turn. Note. Once you cast this spell, you must Safe Rest for 1 week before using it again.

source.note: "Note." is a sidebar box printed under the spell; appended to text. No Upcast line is printed. The STR save decides Incapacitated, not half damage, so no save is encoded. The 1-week reuse limit has no matching limit period, so it is text only.

name: Chillcraft
text: Chill. Harmlessly freeze, thaw, or move a bath-sized amount of water near you. OR: Craft. Conjure a sheet of opaque, mirror-like, or transparent ice the size of a window or door.

source.note: "bath-sized" is split across a line break at the hyphen; kept the hyphen as a real compound.

name: Ice Disk
text: Conjure a floating disk of ice that follows you. It can carry moderately heavy weight for 1 hour or until you cast this spell again.

name: Wintry Scrying
text: Turn a small patch of water into a reflective icy mirror. Looking through it grants you vision of any desired location near this body of water for 10 min.
